description: Create an alternate layout: copy the pages of a layout to a new page size and orientation in the same document, with a liquid page rule, linked stories and copied text styles (Layout > Create Alternate Layout)

copyTextStyles.description: Copy Text Styles to New Style Group

from.description: From Source Pages: the layout to copy (default the first page's layout); see manage_alternate_layouts

height.description: Page height of the new layout (mm)

linkStories.description: Link Stories: the new stories are linked copies of the source stories

liquidPageRule.description: Liquid Page Rule applied to the new pages

orientation.description: Orientation; swaps width and height when they do not match it

smartTextReflow.description: Smart Text Reflow: add or remove pages as text reflows (the document's Type preference, which covers every layout)

width.description: Page width of the new layout (mm)

name: create_alternate_layout
title: Create Alternate Layout
